text:
morgan: tossing an idea out — what if automatic fallback policies can attach a "handshake" token to the response so downstream services can detect and log fallback decisions without parsing headers? thinking about UX, API, and telemetry needs.
arya: handshake token = short stable id for the decision? good for correlating traces. needs to be privacy-safe (no prompt material).
devin: agree. propose token format: `fh_<policyid>_<shorthash>` (e.g., fh_contingencyV2_a3f2). include in response header `X-Redwood-Handshake` and a tiny `fallback_hint` field in JSON body when non-200.
srinivas: important: token should map to a stored decision record that contains only non-PII metadata: policy_id, verdict_time, trigger_metric(s), chosen_variant, storage_ref. UI can fetch record for audit by clicking the token.
taylor: UX thought: in the rollouts list, make an optional column "Fallback Signals" that shows handshake token count and top reasons. clicking the count opens sampled examples. we should show both coarse reason and a short numeric metric (e.g., p95=1800ms).
morgan: telemetry schema suggestion (flat fields): req_ts, req_id, fallback_token, fallback_mode, fallback_reason, metric_value, primary_model, fallback_model, sample_snippet. store sample_snippet only if sampled; max 400 chars.
devin: QA: include a small "compare" action in the console to open primary vs fallback outputs side-by-side for the sample. compute a tiny quality_delta metric (similarity score) and store it as quality_delta.
arya: billing: handshake token should also let billing pipeline classify events (placeholder vs lite vs swap). maybe add `fallback_cost_class` label in telemetry so cost aggregation easily groups.
srinivas: security: access to decision records must be gated. only operators, the owning customer, or internal keys used for sampling can retrieve full audit rows. UI should show redacted preview for others.
morgan: implementation nit: ensure token lifetime and eviction policy match retention (default 30d). token resolution must be fast and cheap (in-memory index + cold-gs fallback). also make token idempotent for identical decision tuples to aid deduping.
taylor: small API proposal: client can opt-in to a header `X-Redwood-Explain: true` which returns `fallback_decision_url` in response when a fallback occurs (only for internal or sampled keys). that URL can show the decision record in the console.
devin: avoid leaking decision URLs to public keys. add signed, time-limited URLs when used externally.
opsbot: deploybot: feature/fallback-handshake rolling to staging at 4380000025 by ci-user.
arya: last question: for metrics dashboards, surface ratio of handshake-bearing responses vs total, plus top fallback_reasons over the window. morgan: yep and enable FFT (fast filter telemetry) so SREs can pivot quickly.
srinivas: ok i'll draft the header + token format and a minimal decision record schema. can we review in 45m?
morgan: works. thanks all!
